US-China AI rivalry and potential dialogue explored

Artificial intelligence has emerged as a critical point in US-China relations, with potential for dialogue on AI safety despite ongoing technological competition. While leaders may compete over technology control, impacting economic and national security, there's a possibility for cooperation on AI safety measures. This comes as former US President Trump has sold tens of millions in AI and tech shares, including those of Microsoft. Some Democrats have urged Trump to seek an AI deal with China, while broader commentary suggests the US must "win AI" over China, with warnings from American AI companies potentially aimed at countering China's rapid advancements and securing US standard-setting control.
